# Test fixtures

`poison.html` is SignalRGB's Poison effect, copied byte for byte from

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\WhirlwindFX\SignalRgb\cache\effects\-Mir7bKkFQmd2LF_9Leg\effect.html

on 2026-10-26, at Luke's request, so that `canvas-html` can be tested against the
original effect it is meant to run. It is **not covered by this repo's license**.

`generic.html` is written for this repo and is covered by the repo's license
(Apache-2.0).
